Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm gonna do some prop comedy for you, and you're gonna like it! Okay, what have we got? (reaches into the box and gets a house) Here's a...here's a house. For, uh...I don't know. A mouse or something. (drops and breaks house; gets a book from his box) Here's a book. Hey, what am I...what am I supposed to do? Read? (throws book) Next! All right, let's see what else we've got! Um, and here's, uh, um... (gets out an oyster shell) Oh! An oyster shell, look! My...my mom went to a seafood restaurant...I don't have any...it's just...to me, it's just interesting. I'll put that one back in the box. (puts shell back in box) What else we got? Oh, here we go. Look! (pulls out Baljeet) A nerd to go with the book!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I got this. Back in the day where men wore miniskirts (Flashback) ...wiggle wiggle wiggle...wiggle wiggle wiggle... (In this flashback, the role of Alexander the Great will be played by Buford; narrates) ...Alexander the Great was vacationing in Gordion, when he came upon a celebrated oxcart that was tied to a post using a knot that was so complicated, it was impossible to untie. So he just sliced it in half in one bold stroke. (End flashback) A simple solution to a complicated problem, hence the phrase, "Cutting the Gordian Knot."

Name: Buford
Dialog: I do! You see, for generations and generations, the Van Stomm family has been the guardian of the secret knowledge and protectors of the mystery capsule. We made the thirteenth-century Templars look like a bunch of wusses. And throughout the ages, our family has pledged our lives to conceal it from the unenlightened. And in doing so, we were entrusted with the only key that can unlock the capsule secrets.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, we met, in Paris. (He flashes back) It was a year ago, and I was taking in some of the local color, when I saw her, Brigitte. She was a beautiful French girl, and I was an ugly American. Which of course holds a certain mystique. With her I completely forgot myself. I read poetry, I wept at beauty, I clipped my toenails. For Brigitte, I even learned to speak the language of love, French talk.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nah, nah! Don't try and confuse me with your sorcerous ways. There's nothin' I've ever seen that would make me believe you could pull this off. Except for that time-machine thing, and oh, and the rollercoaster! But other than that, nothin'! Oh, and the time you played that song when the platypus came back, oh... Man, nature just bends to your will, doesn't it?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (offscreen) Okay. Today's the big day of the Danville Fish Show. (Cut to Buford's bedroom to reveal he's talking to Biff) Are ya nervous? (Close up on Biff who bubbles.) Don't worry about it. It's normal. Just remember today is your day to shine! So we gonna be scared? (as Biff) No, Bufie! (as himself) Are we gonna be tough? (as Biff) Yes, Bufie! (as himself) So let's see whatcha got! (holding a small hoop) Just like we practiced, jump through the hoop. You can do it, buddy! (He moves the hoop around the fish) Jump through the hoop! (He holds up the bowl) Victory!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (voiceover, translating) "I tried fitting myself with a raccoon. I stumbled through the world, seeking connection, but found only fear and scorn. I was so confused, til I saw my own reflection. I was a monster. I tried fillin' myself with garbage. I tried everything to change my appearance. To fit in. Nothin' worked. Until I tried a human host."

Name: Buford
Dialog: After that, I became the bully. And I wasn't afraid of anything or anybody. Except, you know, maybe a giant squid, cause-- Come on, those are freaky, right? All suction cuppy and beaky. (Waves splashing) But then, today...Biff and I decided to go for a swim. After a while, I couldn't hear him anymore. I got worried.

Name: Buford
Dialog: It was easy actually. A lot of the root words are the same in Latin. But I can't let anyone know I have a heart, it'll ruin my tough-guy image. And believe me, the irony is not lost on me in this suit. Aw man, don't you see, if I get all gushy now, I'll be totally exposed! I can't stand it! (He pushes Baljeet aside, and flees the cage)

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm sure you're wondering why I, Buford, have taken a leadership role in such a geek-centered enterprise. Well, take a look around! This place is crawling with nerds! I'm like a kid in a candy store! Plus, I relate to the character of Odaf Underhump and his complex emotional inner journey.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, I bet you! And if you lose, you're gonna have to stand up in front of everyone and say that you are governed by the laws of physics and summer's not whatever you want to make of it. And what's more, you gotta spend the rest of your summer doin' nothin'!

Name: Buford
Dialog: No, no, no! Ohh, I actually thought we were gonna make it! I thought we were gonna do the impossible. For one shining moment...summer was whatever I wanted to make of it! Wait...this is my house! Hold on one second! I'm givin' everybody back their bikes!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, excuse me, but that adjacent area was founded by my great-uncle Otto H. Adjacent! He didn't wanna be no part of no Tri-State unification, and neither do I! The blood of Otto H. Adjacent runs through these veins, and blood is thicker than water! (leaves)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, I don't know how we got here, but my stomach is rumbling. (He gets out of the tub.) Now don't wander off, Chowdina. I'm gonna call ya "Chowdina", cuz, y'know, ya got chowdah in ya. And plus, you look like a Chowdina. Anyway, I'm gonna go bully up somethin' to eat.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't see what everyone's so worried about. I got this system, see? You act any way you want all year long, but then right before Christmas, you do one big selfless act of kindness and Santa will wipe your slate clean. Works like a charm.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (He sighs heavily) Oh, Brigitte, I've spent years building up my tough-guy street cred. I can bounce back from the fuzzy bear suit, but being in love with a beautiful, sweet, exotic girl like yourself… If people found out about that, my image would be fini

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, they weren't selling anyway. Not on my watch. (Another beam hits the helium tank, and it floats away) Ah! The helium tank! Actually it's kinda ironic when you think about it. (He sees another beam heading towards him, and in slow motions blocks the beam with his body) Not on my watch! (He begins floating upward) Yes! The human shield tactic never fails. (He notices his shoe laces are caught on the tooth) man, I knew I should have hung onto that laser.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And you might wanna rethink that! I mean, it would be a shame if this double-Dutch chocolate mocha espresso you've been drinking, were to, say, I don't know, splishy-splash on all those pristine white lab coats you got back there.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, and Helen could launch a thousand ships with her face! My favorite character was Achilles, the greatest Greek warrior of all time. He had this big fight with Hector. He was all, 'Wham! Bam! Stab! Stab! Stab!'

Name: Buford
Dialog: That was amazing! I never thought quilting could be so much fun! Think of the possibilities! Needlepoint! Embroidery! Tapestry! I'm headin' down to the fabric store right now! (walks away) Broquet! Taffeta! Saddle stitch!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, and I made gourd helmets, by the way. (Buford starts giving the gourd helmets to his friends.) Here. Here. No, wait, Baljeet, this is yours. Phineas. I like to think each individual's gourd helmet captures their unique essence in some way, you know, in gourd.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So you lost your best friend, huh? Yeah, I know how you feel. I lost my best friend once. Little guy, all yellow-y and scaly. His name was Biff, turned into this whole brouhaha. I had to fight a squid.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So you lost your best friend, huh? Yeah, I know how you feel. I lost my best friend once. Little guy, all yellow-y and scaly. His name was Biff, turned into this whole brouhaha. I had to fight a squid.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I can see how helping you take over the Tri-State Area would afford me many new bullying opportunities. But what's with the back-story, dude? I mean, who needs a special reason to boss people around?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Like I said before, losing to a girl doesn't count. (gets zapped by Doofenshmirtz's -inator) What I meant to say was I had a wonderful time. I guess you were right. Girls are just as good as boys. Thanks again. Woo-hoo! The F-Games rock.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, we're out of credit at the emergency room. My mom said if I break one more bone, she's gonna break the rest of them! Fairly sure that was hyperbole, besides, look how hard that hydrant is!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It doesn't matter anyway! Sooner or later, they're gonna figure out we're in here; then they're gonna come in here! They're gonna come in here and they're gonna come in here and they're gonna—

Name: Buford
Dialog: Guys, can you settle an argument for us? Preferably in my favor? If a vegetarian becomes a zombie, would they start eatin' people? (referring to Baljeet) Mr. Smartyunderpants thinks they just keep eatin' vegetables.

Name: Buford
Dialog: There are two things you should know about the Van Stomms. One, we always set our alarms on time, and two, if we don't, we show up early and take our lumps. We've even got a **song** about it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: If becomin' one with nature means havin' to leave you behind, I want none of that! Hey, you, trash birds! That's right, ya dirty sky-rats! I've had it with yer stupid squawkin'! Shame! Shame!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Aw man! Random green rays from the sky! I forgot about random green rays from the sky! Oh, no, not on my watch. (He throws assorted objects in the path of a green rays) Oh, man, I've run out of conveniently placed objects. Bingo. (He runs, and grabs Irving's helium balloon) Coming through!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, sure, two vegetable samosas! Why don't we all just dress like vegetable samosas? In fact, why don't we just all dress like mashed potatoes and take the word exotic right off the sign?!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? I didn't take nothing out of nowhere. But, uhm, just as a hypothetical. Uh... What do you think would happen if say you took that goofy doohickey-thing out of the thingamawhatsit?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Look, some people tend to think I'm a bit harsh with these guys. But here's how I see it. DISGUSTING! UTTER GARBAGE! RAW SEWAGE ON A PLATE! It's really all about nurturing the talent.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Don't get too excited. I'm goin' to film school. I'm concentrating on tragedies. The story of a struggling orphan's transcendental search, for meaning in a post-apocalyptic society.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You know it's kinda nice to sit back and relax after all that manual labor. (The floating effect wears off of him and the other objects hit by the -inator) Uh-oh. (He plunges downward) Ahhhhhh! I've got a song about how Van Stomms fall from the sky too, but, it doesn't end well.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? No! I'm not gonna eat my friend. You're the best thing that's ever happened to me! And the third best thing that's happened to Volley-Baljeet, right? (imitating Baljeet) "My face is blood."

Name: Buford
Dialog: And if by "zoetrope", ya mean a 19th century optical toy consisting of a cylinder with pictures on the inner servers that produce the illusion of motion, I'm not impressed.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I've completely protected their invention from airplane snags, stray balloons, meteorites, flocks of wild gazelles, and giant cracks that form in the crust of the Earth.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Tristan is not a flamingo, he's from outer space, and he's a whalemingo. But then he had to go home, and I never saw him again. Hey! What are you doin' with your hands?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (demonstrating how to add in the picture, tilting the game controller and wildly pushing buttons) And then you do this, and this, and this and this and this and this and this, and this, and this, and this, and this and this, and then this and this, and then that.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, the throwin' was good! But when you grabbed my shirt, you didn't twist!! I swear, it's like in one ear and right out the other! Oh, oh! Baljeet, wait up! (goes after him)

Name: Buford
Dialog: And that's how I won my goldfish. I named it Biff, after my mother. It was the happiest day of my life. I finally had a friend. But then I met the local bully.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Not hardly. I swiped this bad-boy (His rivet gun) from the orthodontist's section, to cut off stuff sticking out of the ride that could snag a passing plane as they go along.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I always knew it would end like this. Like, specifically like this. Me being dragged off by the tentacles of giant sentient brains that used to be my friends!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I think about you often, whalemingo. Especially when I've had spicy tacos just before bed. And your feathers, they tickle me in my dreams. Tristan! Tristan...

Name: Buford
Dialog: You got this, Candace! Don't get nervous and make a series of bad decisions that cause you to fail your driver's test and haunt ya for the rest of yer life!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What's wrong with him? I feel like we've been hanging here for weeks. I mean, I got the brawn for it, but it's not like I don't have other stuff to do.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (translating) "I only wanted a life, friends, family. And when I saw your friends, Candace, I saw you had everything anyone could want. I didn't wanna give that up."

Name: Buford
Dialog: So then the seamstress walks back into the stateroom and says, " 'Titanium'? I thought she said 'cranium'!" Hahaha, yeah. Pretty good punch line, huh?

Name: Buford
Dialog: That's good, 'cause I still got ya number! Or would that be 'numbers'? I don't know. (Candace enters, grabs both Baljeets and leaves.) Hey, Baljeet, which one would be grammatically correct? (Gasps as he suddenly notices that both Baljeets have disappeared.) How rude.

Name: Buford
Dialog: How should I know? They never showed up for me to return serve. That's considered a forfeit in catapult badminton, so I went to get some Victory Gum.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ya know what I hate about The Unclimbable Mountain of Unclimbableness? Just to get there you have to cross the Uncrossable River of Uncrossableness.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (happily) Teddy Boo Boo! (angrily) Where have you been, you bad bear?! I bet you've been on the road again, haven't you?! Well, you're grounded, mister! (happily) Oh, I love you!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, sweet, sweet closure. Maybe we'll even find the last shard, or face the Puzzle Master, or discover the identity of the man in really dark grey!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Now they're headed for the junkyard. From whose gravitational pull, it'll be impossible to escape. Am I thinkin' of a junkyard, or something else?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's an interesting question you pose, as it reveals not only one's impulses and desires but one's deepest fears as well. I'll go with Belchman.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Fooled ya'! It's me, Buford! And my voice isn't horrible, it's raspy! You gotta spend hours screamin' in the closet to get it like this. Hours!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wait a minute! Okay, stay with me on this. She's empty and all alone in this world, right? Well, I know someone else who's empty and all alone.

Name: Buford
Dialog: With the hurly-burly of my busy social calendar, I often forget to have quality time with my pet goldfish, Biff. (bows) So I shall smell...you later. (he exits)

Name: Buford
Dialog: And if you follow me now, you'll see Candace's recurring nightmares. Come on, people. Try and stay with the group. (they see everyone running from the id) Hey, where are they going? (he sees the id and screams)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Aaah, fine! I was feeling creatively stifled by you anyway! (at grocer) And you! You just cost me a perfectly good nerd! Maybe I'll make you my new nerd.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Still floating on the balloon, and seeing the Tri-State area) Wow, it's all just one, big place. No Bi-State area. No Adjacent Area, It's all just one big Tri-State Area, right over there! (The string he was holding onto rips off the balloon, opening a hole on the balloon) Uh-oh. Mamma!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Farewell, Chowdina. Farewell. Chowdina, won't you say goodbye? Oh, that's right. Your voice was just a coping mechanism. "Farewell, Buford."

Name: Buford
Dialog: Alright, you two, let's get somethin' straight here. There'll be NO messin' with the Buford. Don't make no diff how many of you there are!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, oh! Can I blow a super huge one? So I can crawl inside it and float around like a little woodland pixie? (stops, realizing his mistake) Did I just say that out loud?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nah, just messin' with ya. I found it on the other side of the fence. I saw it fall out of the lock when the capsule dropped from the sky.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Suddenly, from out of the shadows, (making a shadow puppet) the zombie bunny rabbit appeared and then he...ate up all the marshmallows!!! Numnumnumnumnumnunmnum!!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (in background) The sun is on the meridian and the wind is blowing out of the southeast (onscreen; he too is "hypnotized".) and temperature is the perfect balmy 75°. (Isabella slaps him; he comes to.) Whoa! Thanks, Isabella.

Name: Buford
Dialog: So what you're sayin' is that it advocates a mixed economy, where significant roles are played by the private sector, and the government?

Name: Buford
Dialog: We were just...at the bounce house...down at the Meatloaf Festival...and...and I was there, you know, having a good time, and suddenly...

Name: Buford
Dialog: (Cracks his fingers) Excusez-moi mon bon monsieur. Auriez-vous par hazard un soupçon d'huile de cuisson que nous pourrions utiliser sans nous démerder un sou? (Excuse me, good sir. Would you by chance have a touch of cooking oil that we could use without losing a penny?)

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't want your life story. Grab a shield, come back with it, or on it. Irving, go get some more baklava, come back with it, or on it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: My mom always just throws all our leftovers into a pot and makes a giant casserole. (to Isabella) It's best to just eat first and ask questions later.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Chowdina! What happened to the magic? Did I do something wrong? It's okay, Chowdina. Even if I have to carry you back, we'll find a way.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yes! (Sobbing) He changed my life, you know. I used to be a wimp, like you. But then, one day, at the carnival, I was somehow drawn to this game.

Name: Buford
Dialog: This is it! This is how Stumbleberry Finkbat ends! The Man in Really Dark Grey swings in to rescue the Freakishly Long-Necked Princess!

Name: Buford
Dialog: You gotta be kiddin' me! Who looked at this idea and said, "Yeah, that'd be fun"?! Y'see?! This is what happens when we have no intro!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Y'know, some days you're flyin' high on a green cloud of friendship magic, while others, you're fish food in the bottom of the ocean.

Name: Buford
Dialog: And my eyes hurt from watchin' ya do it. Hey! What if we grew a giant banana, and made a giant peeler, so we'll only hafta peel once?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ladies, I was lookin' for some makeup to prank Baljeet, but I see now we're playin' truth-or-dare. Dare me anythin'. I only do dares.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What gets me is, why did the Trojan War take so long? If I were Achilles, I could've taken the city of Troy, like, in one afternoon.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, we finally got to the musical part of the story. We all decided it was high time to teach the squirrels how to be squirrels.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Argh! One day somebody's gonna ask me for some obscure musical instrument, and it ain't gonna be there. What's gonna happen then? (Pulls out the piccolo and plays the Eb above high C)

Name: Buford
Dialog: (to Baljeet) Okay, Sleepmaster General, it's 9:29. Hand over the skin-safe nontoxic markers so I can draw on your face when you fall asleep.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Eh, I'm more of a lingonberry kind of guy. (Candace returns to the backyard as Gary Frank) Hey, you're back. I'll take a large pie with andouille sausage and chocolate chips.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (voiceover) ...to string up our Christmas lights, but she always forgets to take 'em down! So, year after year, he hangs up more, until...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, Baljeet! (Hulkjeet roars and picks Buford up by the shirt.) Heh heh heh...heh...I'm so happy that I found you! I worry about you, you know. Because...you're my best friend.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Has it only been three months? 'Cause I've been adding up all of the things we built this summer, and we're way over one-fif—

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, main title, whatever. But I think I see the potential. Like, you could use them to make a giant birthday paddle.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm just sayin', ev'rything the guy owns is black! You think maybe... (Candace signals for them to stop) What? (Cut to Leia putting the disc in R2-D2) Oh, there's somebody doin' somethin' over there.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah! Couch! I couldn't think of the word! There's also this big metal device labeled "vaporizer-inator". But it's broken.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Sorry, Dr. Doothenasia. But there comes a time when you don't wanna bully everyone. (He looks back dramatically, with a single tear falling from his eye) You just wanna bully someone you love.

Name: Buford
Dialog: We could tie each of you to a monster truck and drive in opposite directions. Worst-case scenario, someone loses a torso.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (walking over to Phineas and Ferb) Yeah, it's pretty mega, but is it really grand finale material worthy (hugs Phineas and Ferb) of these two guys? (pausing and realizing what he did) I just made it weird, didn't I?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ah, no can do, Dinner Bell! It's family day, and the Van Stomms from the low countries are visiting. (walks away) Buford is outie, G!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Found this perfectly good robe just lying around. Has one hole, right here. Hey, look what else I just found! My hoagie!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'll be the judge of that, step aside. This better be worth a quarter. (Sarcastically, as the ride shakes back and forth) Ooh. This is so exciting. Let me catch my breath.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, come on! It was so obvious! She came over to your house every day for eleven years, just to see what you were doin'!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Good job, cadets! Now, back down the tree. No, not like that! Head first! Sheesh, it's like I'm talking to myself here.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Her loss. The Van Stomm's "Accept a Challenge" song has a killer bridge. It goes to an F sharp minor, in the key of G!

Name: Buford
Dialog: And even though it was funny, I still kinda wish that the bounce house was still there. You know, for the little kids.

Name: Buford
Dialog: No! Listen up, wave! You're not takin' her! For Chowdina, I'll bully the laws of nature into submission! Shame! Shame!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, I'm no scientist, but dere's a big rectangular upholstered object... I'm gonna say mid-century modern, kinda...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, you're the only one here to talk to. Except for Volley-Baljeet. (He picks up a Wilson-type ball, imitating Baljeet.) "I do not use contractions." (stomach growls) Buford so hungry.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Brain teasers, huh? Alright you do all the ones that rely on brains, and I'll do all the ones that rely on teasin'.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Look at what Baljeet did to my candy bar. He got his peanut butter on my chocolate. Look at this mess! Look at it! (shoves the candy bar in Phineas's face)

Name: Buford
Dialog: (grabbing a ladder) Hey, everybody, what say we put aside our differences long enough to enjoy this unexpected, comically large wheel?

Name: Buford
Dialog: There they are. I thought we'd never catch up. Goin' old school this year, I see. Sweet. No costume, huh, Candace?

Name: Buford
Dialog: That was cool! I didn't have to do anything! The outfit did all the work! Whoa Phineas, which way are you facing?

Name: Buford
Dialog: First, let's get one thing straight: I'm not crying. I'm just sweating through my eyes. And second...I lost Biff! (Sobbing)

Name: Buford
Dialog: I've got his right arm. (Perry is forced to slap himself again) Why are you hitting yourself? Why are you hitting yourself? Why are you hitting yourself? (Laughs)

Name: Buford
Dialog: (turns on lights) I'm workin' my way through everyone in Danville. It's a callin'. Here ya go. (opens a cabinet door) I gotta buncha Candaces right here.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hold your words, outlander! Once Odaf Underhump has made a hasty and ill-informed decision, he cannot be swayed.

Name: Buford
Dialog: No, no, no, no, no! Ya gotta have pranks! Prank calls, Prank Sinatra, prank hand in warm water, stuff like that.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What does it look like? I'm running away, hoping that while the monster is busy eating my friends, I can escape.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I wuz just thinkin', wouldn't it be cathartic ta pound a buncha carnivorous plants inta submission with a book?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, look at the little guys, they're like little bullies! I am both proud and ready to soil my pants in terror.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, I got the legs for it. (takes off wig) Ah, New Mexico. My great grandfather once saw something mysterious in New Mexico...

Name: Buford
Dialog: I know what we're gonna do today! We're gonna build a stick-throwing target practice arena! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Of all the clearings, in all the woods, in all the world, she had to walk into mine. (Buford's phone rings) Tell me she was deported!

Name: Buford
Dialog: You know, this smoothie isn't really unusual or exotic. It's about as exotic as a stay-cation with Aunt Meryl!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Fine, for the record though, it's the "Be Prepared for Every Eventuality" song. It's in the imperative tense. (walks away angrily)

Name: Buford
Dialog: The forest is crawlin' with patch-crazed Europeans and I'm a bear in the woods. What do you think I'm doing?

Name: Buford
Dialog: No! No, you should not! (he is wearing the helmet) I used my now vastly superior intellect to build the world's largest wedgie machine!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, Ferb says I should tell you we're about to start washing the house, and you can help us out if you want!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wait a second. (slaps self) I coulda eaten the coconut! Eh, too much work. Sorry, stomach. Turns out I'm a poor provider.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Took a few tries there! If I were thinking, I woulda just pressed this "fly" button. (He presses the fly button, causing the giant tire swing to launch, taking the pedestal with it) Oh, that kind of fly!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (From atop a building, overlook the parade) If that parade makes it to the end, my hopes for the Adjacent Area secession are through. I gotta stop it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Whoa, that's weird. I could throw balls no problem. (gets out a baseball) Watch dis! Dat can! Dat mosquito! Dat Hadron collider!

Name: Buford
Dialog: You're lucky the gross factor outweighs the science factor, or you'd have a one-way ticket to wedgie town!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Sorry to come back empty-handed, Chowdina. This whole food chain thing is more complicated than I thought.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Huh, that's Swiss-picious! Well, I did it! A hundred cheese puns! (Seeing Perry walk up to them) Oh, and look, there's Perry! (Buford looks at the audience and bows.) And, scene.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Thanks! I'm gonna put Biff's prize money in a scholarship fund for that fancy fish school in the Maldives!

Name: Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)
Dialog: I see you're into spider webs. Sure, they're classic, but overdone. We see you as more of a modern witch.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (chewing gum) My chiropractor recommended it. It's just as humiliating as a half-nelson, and easier on my tennis elbow. (crunching loudly)

Name: Buford
Dialog: I got a pail of water, and a nest to make comfortable. I figure I can keep him in my garage 'till spring.

Name: Buford
